nora: quick follow-up from last night's midnight OOM on c64-03. symptoms: shard residency never shrank after client disconnect; jemalloc.retained jumped ~11%. posting compact action list.
devin: pls put the checklist here so I can book a small maintenance window.
mika: uploaded a small heap diff to gs://redwood-perf/oom/2823456789/heap-diff.svg and jemalloc.stats. retention ratio suggests fragmentation rather than live leak.
nora: actions (short):
- R1: distributed jemalloc arena dumps + cross-canary heap scans  owner: @mika  due: 2026-03-05
- R2: staging TTL eviction: shards idle >25m evict policy  owner: @devin  due: 2026-03-04
- R3: prototype low-priority background compactor with CPU cap and feature flag  owner: @nora  due: 2026-03-12
- R4: add metric kv_idle_count and alert if rising >15%/2h  owner: @runbooks  due: 2026-03-03
- R5: emergency rollback doc & quick-toggle that disables compactor and reverts TTL  owner: @devin  due: 2026-03-04
mika: started R1, uploading dumps now. will post flamegraphs and a short write-up.
devin: scheduling R2 to staging 2026-03-04 02:30 UTC, will run 4h smoke and report kv_residency_size, kv_fragmentation, p95.
sre-bot: deploy-notice: staging change scheduled by devin at 2026-03-04 02:30 UTC. CI: green.
nora: rollout plan: config-only canary at 10% traffic for 2h, monitor p95 and error-rate; compactor behind flag and canary at 5%. rollback if p95 > baseline+20ms or error-rate spike.
runbooks: added runbook entry "residency-surge" with steps to run R1 and quick escalation template. heuristic added: if jemalloc.retained / rss > 1.08 -> prioritize compaction.
nora: thanks team. update this thread with results or blockers. :white_check_mark:
